name: Agumon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name (other than [DoruGreymon], [BurningGreymon] or [DexDoruGreymon]) and 1 Digimon card with [Omnimon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
